title: Homebrew Package Manager
description: Install, update, and manage packages on macOS and Linux with Homebrew.

entries.label: Install Package
entries.description: Install a formula (CLI tool) from the Homebrew repository

entries.label: Install GUI App (Cask)
entries.description: Install a macOS GUI application (e.g., firefox, docker, iterm2)

entries.label: Update Everything
entries.command: brew update && brew upgrade && brew cleanup
entries.description: Fetch latest versions, upgrade all packages, and remove old versions

entries.label: Search Packages
entries.description: Search for available formulae and casks matching a query

entries.label: Package Info
entries.description: Show details about a package — version, dependencies, install size

entries.label: List Installed
entries.description: List all installed CLI formulae (use --cask for GUI apps)

entries.label: Uninstall Package
entries.description: Remove a package and its cellar files

entries.label: Add Third-Party Tap
entries.description: Add a third-party repository to access additional formulae

entries.label: Manage Services
entries.description: Show background services managed by Homebrew (postgres, redis, etc.)

entries.label: Start Background Service
entries.description: Start a service and configure it to launch at login

entries.label: Doctor — Diagnose Issues
entries.description: Check your Homebrew installation for common problems
